patterns.fee: Fees\s+These course fees are for international students only\.(?:.|\n){0,120}?Semester 1\s+AUD \$[0-9,]+(?:\s+AUD \$[0-9,]+)?[\s*-]*Semester 2\s+AUD \$[0-9,]+(?:\s+AUD \$[0-9,]+)?[\s*-]*Fee Totals\s+AUD \$([0-9,]+)

config.notes: TAFE SA. International course pages are /xml/course/in/in_[YEAR]<code>.aspx (YEAR = intake year). Header: Duration (incl. holidays) / Semester(s) / Teaching Duration; International Applications table: Campus / Location, Study Mode, Contact Hours, Study Load, Commences (months, e.g. January, July). Course Admission Requirements (for International Applications) gives IELTS overall and bands. Fees section is international-only, printed PER SEMESTER (Semester 1..n) with Fee Totals = whole course; the fee pattern reads Fee Totals only when the table has exactly two semesters (= one academic year of tuition). Courses of 1.5 semesters (e.g. 39 weeks) also print two fee lines, so their Fee Totals is the whole (sub-annual) course - check against duration before admitting fees. One-semester and multi-year courses give no annual figure. Domestic pages (/xml/course/aw/, /courses/...) and reverse-credit pages carry no international intakes/fees. Central English: https://www.tafesa.edu.au/international/entry-requirements (Academic IELTS 6.0, 5.0 all bands, most courses). Term dates: https://students.tafesa.edu.au/getting-started/term-dates (course pages print months directly, so no term_months).
